id: title:Gilbert09:retry a transient google token refresh error

review.posthog_relevance: Adds transient error recovery and OAuth token refresh handling to warehouse ingestion, potentially reducing ingestion failures during temporary Google API outages.
review.reason: The observed hunk P1.F3.H1 explicitly adds transient-refresh-error detection and a retry policy, distinguishing transient HTML-page errors from persistent credential errors. This represents a substantive, bounded improvement in warehouse ingestion reliability and recovery, warranting a score of 2. No tier 3 systemic risk reduction or tier 1 maintenance-only characteristics are seen
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on the frequency and duration of transient Google token-refresh outages, which is not established by the code alone. The score does not account for unverified adoption or incident avoidance.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment performed; score and confidence withheld.

observations.behavior: Adds Google Sheets OAuth token refresh and transport error handling, including a new transient-refresh-error detection and retry policy.
observations.posthog_connection: This could reduce warehouse ingestion failures during transient Google token-refresh outages, allowing recovery without permanent failure, while distinguishing transient HTML-page errors from persistent credential errors.
